title: MLE-World: Predicting Machine Learning Experiment Outcomes with a Learned World Model
title_zh: MLE-World：利用学习到的世界模型预测机器学习实验结果

paragraphs.en: AI research agents can propose, execute, and improve programs that solve machine learning tasks. However, executing each candidate program requires training and evaluating ML models, limiting how many candidates an agent can explore at each step. We introduce MLE-World, a world model finetuned from Qwen3.5-4B that predicts a program’s terminal output (error traces, training logs, and validation scores) from its code and data description without executing it, together with a confidence score estimating the prediction’s correctness. Because a prediction costs one inference call rather than a training run, MLE-World makes test time scaling (TTS) affordable for these agents. We build five TTS policies, guided by MLE-World, that compare several candidates per step by their predicted outputs: Sequential revision, Best-of- N N , Pairwise judging, Fusion, and a UCB style rule that also adds an exploration bonus from this confidence score. Since predictions can be wrong, we run a candidate for real only when its confidence score is low. On 17 MLE-bench Lite tasks, MLE-World matches the real terminal output on 77.9% of held out programs, versus 41.1% for much larger prompted models. MLE-World guided TTS achieves up to 22.1% higher observed mean performance than the agent without a world model, with less real execution. Project webpage: https://mle-world.github.io/ .
paragraphs.zh: AI研究智能体能够提出、执行并改进解决机器学习任务的程序。 然而，执行每个候选程序都需要训练和评估机器学习模型，这限制了智能体在每一步能够探索的候选数量。 我们提出 MLE-World，这是一个从 Qwen3.5-4B 微调而来的世界模型，它无需执行程序，即可根据程序的代码和数据描述预测其终端输出（错误堆栈、训练日志和验证分数），并同时给出一个估计预测正确性的置信度分数。 由于一次预测只需一次推理调用而非一次训练运行，MLE-World 使测试时扩展（TTS）对这类智能体变得可负担。 我们构建了五种由 MLE-World 引导的 TTS 策略，它们在每一步根据预测输出比较若干候选：顺序修订、Best-of-N、成对评判、Fusion，以及一种 UCB 风格的规则，后者还利用置信度分数增加了探索奖励。 由于预测可能出错，我们只在候选的置信度分数较低时才真正运行它。 在 17 个 MLE-bench Lite 任务上，MLE-World 在 77.9% 的留出程序上与真实终端输出一致，而规模大得多的提示模型仅为 41.1%。 与没有世界模型的智能体相比，MLE-World 引导的 TTS 在实际观测到的平均性能上最高提升 22.1%，同时所需的真实执行更少。 项目网页：https://mle-world.github.io/ 。

paragraphs.en: AI research agents repeatedly write programs, execute them, inspect terminal output, and revise solutions ( Jiang et al., 2025 ; Nam et al., 2026 ) , but this feedback is expensive because each step trains and evaluates a model. Therefore, execution time limits how many ideas they can test ( Toledo et al., 2026 ; Hambardzumyan et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026a ) , making cheap feedback and selective execution central to efficient search.
paragraphs.zh: AI 研究智能体反复编写程序、执行程序、检查终端输出并修改解决方案（Jiang et al., 2025；Nam et al., 2026），但这种反馈代价高昂，因为每一步都需要训练和评估一个模型。 因此，执行时间限制了它们能测试的想法数量（Toledo et al., 2026；Hambardzumyan et al., 2026；Yang et al., 2026a），这使得廉价的反馈和有选择的执行成为高效搜索的核心。

paragraphs.en: Prior work prunes unpromising branches ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Toledo et al., 2026 ) , predicts model performance ( Kulibaba et al., 2025 ) , or ranks candidates before execution ( Zheng et al., 2026 ; Foster et al., 2026 ) . Pruning and ranking can reduce total execution cost, but the cost per execution remains unchanged, and they do not provide terminal output, such as error traces and training logs, to guide subsequent debugging and program revision.
paragraphs.zh: 已有工作通过剪除无希望的分支（Liu et al., 2025；Toledo et al., 2026）、预测模型性能（Kulibaba et al., 2025）或在执行前对候选进行排序（Zheng et al., 2026；Foster et al., 2026）。 剪枝和排序可以降低总执行成本，但每次执行的成本保持不变，而且它们不提供终端输出（如错误堆栈和训练日志）来指导后续的调试和程序修改。

paragraphs.en: The high cost of training makes machine learning engineering (MLE) a natural setting for world models that predict execution feedback without running the program ( Yang, 2026 ) . MLE-World predicts a candidate solution’s terminal output from its code and the task’s data description. We finetune Qwen3.5-4B on logged pairs of code and output from successful and failed runs. One inference call predicts error traces, training logs, and the validation score, supporting both debugging and candidate selection.
paragraphs.zh: 训练的高成本使得机器学习工程（MLE）成为世界模型的自然应用场景，这类模型无需实际运行程序即可预测执行反馈（ Yang, 2026 ）。 MLE-World 根据候选解决方案的代码和任务的数据描述来预测其终端输出。 我们在成功运行与失败运行所记录的代码—输出配对数据上对 Qwen3.5-4B 进行微调。 一次推理调用即可预测错误轨迹、训练日志和验证得分，同时支持调试与候选方案选择。

paragraphs.en: Cheap predicted feedback makes test time scaling (TTS) affordable for MLE agents. TTS can scale along two dimensions: sampling more complete trajectories ( Brown et al., 2024 ; Snell et al., 2024 ) or taking more interaction steps within a trajectory ( Shen et al., 2025 ) . In MLE, both require additional training runs, limiting search under a fixed time budget. Prior agents execute every candidate ( Nam et al., 2026 ) or rank candidates without execution feedback ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) . We focus on scaling interactions so the agent can adapt to feedback throughout the search. MLE-World makes this affordable by letting the agent compare several candidates using predicted error traces, training logs, and scores, then execute only the selected candidate. We build five policies on these predictions: Best-of- N N (BoN), Sequential revision, Pairwise judging, Fusion, and a rule based on upper confidence bounds (UCB).
paragraphs.zh: 廉价的预测反馈使测试时扩展（TTS）对于 MLE 智能体而言变得可负担。 TTS 可以沿两个维度扩展：采样更多完整的轨迹（Brown et al., 2024；Snell et al., 2024），或在一条轨迹内采取更多交互步骤（Shen et al., 2025）。 在 MLE 中，两者都需要额外的训练运行，限制了固定时间预算下的搜索。 此前的智能体要么执行每个候选方案（Nam et al., 2026），要么在没有执行反馈的情况下对候选方案进行排序（Zheng et al., 2026）。 我们专注于扩展交互，使智能体能够在整个搜索过程中适应反馈。 MLE-World 通过让智能体利用预测的报错记录、训练日志和分数来比较多个候选方案，然后仅执行被选中的候选方案，使这一过程变得可负担。 我们基于这些预测构建了五种策略：Best-of-N（BoN）、顺序修订、成对评判、融合，以及一种基于置信度上界（UCB）的规则。

sents.zh: 廉价的预测反馈使测试时扩展（TTS）对于 MLE 智能体而言变得可负担。

sents.en: TTS can scale along two dimensions: sampling more complete trajectories ( Brown et al., 2024 ; Snell et al., 2024 ) or taking more interaction steps within a trajectory ( Shen et al., 2025 ) .

sents.zh: 我们专注于扩展交互，使智能体能够在整个搜索过程中适应反馈。

sents.en: MLE-World makes this affordable by letting the agent compare several candidates using predicted error traces, training logs, and scores, then execute only the selected candidate.
sents.zh: MLE-World 通过让智能体利用预测的报错记录、训练日志和分数来比较多个候选方案，然后仅执行被选中的候选方案，使这一过程变得可负担。

sents.en: We build five policies on these predictions: Best-of- N N (BoN), Sequential revision, Pairwise judging, Fusion, and a rule based on upper confidence bounds (UCB).
sents.zh: 我们基于这些预测构建了五种策略：Best-of-N（BoN）、顺序修订、成对评判、融合，以及一种基于置信度上界（UCB）的规则。

paragraphs.en: MLE-World also reports a confidence score with each prediction, which serves search in two ways. First, it guides selection. Greedy selection by validation score can limit exploration ( Toledo et al., 2026 ; Hambardzumyan et al., 2026 ) and overlook candidates the world model undervalues, so UCB adds an uncertainty bonus to predicted quality. Second, it decides when to trust a prediction. Wrong predictions can mislead search ( Janner et al., 2019 ) , so a confidence gate trusts confident predictions and runs the real execution. The gate works with any of the five policies.
paragraphs.zh: MLE-World 还会为每条预测报告一个置信度分数，该分数在两个方面为搜索服务。 首先，它指导选择。 仅依据验证分数的贪婪选择可能限制探索（Toledo et al., 2026; Hambardzumyan et al., 2026），并忽视被世界模型低估的候选方案，因此 UCB 在预测质量的基础上加入一个不确定性奖励。 其次，它决定何时信任一条预测。 错误的预测可能误导搜索（Janner et al., 2019），因此置信度门控会信任置信度高的预测并运行真实执行。 该门控可与五种策略中的任意一种配合使用。

paragraphs.en: Across 17 MLE-bench Lite tasks ( Chan et al., 2025 ) , MLE-World matches observed terminal output on 77.9% of held out programs versus 41.1% for the best prompted baseline, with 13–1,061 × \times less GPU inference time. MLE-World guided search achieves up to 22.1% higher observed mean performance than the agent without a world model while reducing real execution. These results suggest that cheap feedback from a world model enables test time scaling, improving agent performance by exploring more candidate programs.
paragraphs.zh: 在 17 个 MLE-bench Lite 任务（Chan et al., 2025）上，MLE-World 在 77.9% 的保留程序上匹配了观测到的终端输出，而最佳提示基线仅为 41.1%，且 GPU 推理时间减少 13–1,061 倍。 MLE-World 引导的搜索比没有世界模型的智能体获得了高达 22.1% 的观测平均性能提升，同时减少了真实执行。 这些结果表明，来自世界模型的廉价反馈能够实现测试时扩展，通过探索更多候选程序来提升智能体的性能。

paragraphs.en: MLE agents reduce execution cost through pruning ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Toledo et al., 2026 ) , performance prediction ( Kulibaba et al., 2025 ) , or candidate ranking ( Foster et al., 2026 ; White et al., 2021 ) . ForeAgent ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) uses pairwise preference and a confidence gate to select a candidate for execution. Scores and preferences guide selection but lack error traces for debugging, which may require waiting for costly runs to fail. MLE-World predicts terminal output to support both selection and revision, using confidence to decide when real execution is needed.
paragraphs.zh: MLE 智能体通过剪枝（Liu et al., 2025；Toledo et al., 2026）、性能预测（Kulibaba et al., 2025）或候选排序（Foster et al., 2026；White et al., 2021）来降低执行成本。 ForeAgent（Zheng et al., 2026）使用成对偏好和置信度门控来选择待执行的候选方案。 分数和偏好虽然能指导选择，但缺乏用于调试的错误轨迹，这可能需要等待代价高昂的运行失败后才能获得。 MLE-World 通过预测终端输出同时支持选择和修订，并利用置信度来决定何时需要真实执行。

paragraphs.en: World models predict an action’s outcome without performing it ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ; Hafner et al., 2019 ; Janner et al., 2019 ) . LLM world models, prompted ( Thimmaiah et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2024 ; Gu et al., 2024 ) or trained on agent logs ( Chae et al., 2025 ; Fang et al., 2025 ; Yu et al., 2025 ; Guan et al., 2026 ; Sun et al., 2026 ; Zuo et al., 2026 ) , serve web, computer use, and software agents. Closest to ours, DSWorld ( Yang et al., 2026b ) simulates individual steps in a data science workflow and uses operation cost to decide when to simulate. MLE-World instead predicts a complete program’s terminal output, including error traces, training logs, and validation scores, to guide program search. It uses prediction confidence to decide when real execution is needed, targeting unreliable feedback rather than expensive operations alone.

paragraphs.en: We build on AIDE ( Jiang et al., 2025 ) (although MLE-World is compatible with other agent scaffolds), the reference scaffold of MLE-bench ( Chan et al., 2025 ) and the base of most later MLE agents ( Liu et al., 2025 ; Toledo et al., 2026 ; Ou et al., 2025 ) . AIDE searches for a program s s that solves task τ \tau over a tree whose nodes are programs and whose edges are three operators: Draft writes a new program, Debug rewrites a buggy parent, and Improve makes one atomic change to a valid parent. For fixed execution settings, the real executor E E returns terminal output o = E ⁡ ( τ , s ) o=E(\tau,s) : training logs, the error trace on failure, and the validation score the program computes on a held out split of the training data. An LLM parser reads o o and returns a bug flag and the score. The policy drafts a few initial solutions, debugs buggy nodes up to a fixed depth, and otherwise improves the best valid node; the node with the best validation score is submitted and graded on the hidden test set against the leaderboard. Every node costs one execution.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 AIDE（Jiang et al., 2025）的基础上构建（尽管 MLE-World 兼容其他智能体框架），AIDE 是 MLE-bench（Chan et al., 2025）的参考框架，也是后续大多数 MLE 智能体（Liu et al., 2025；Toledo et al., 2026；Ou et al., 2025）的基础。 AIDE 在一棵树上搜索能解决任务 τ 的程序 s，树的节点是程序，边是三种算子：Draft 撰写一个新程序，Debug 重写一个有缺陷的父节点，Improve 对一个有效的父节点做一处原子性修改。 在固定的执行设置下，真实执行器 E 返回最终输出 o = E(τ, s)：训练日志、失败时的错误跟踪信息，以及该程序在训练数据留出划分上计算得到的验证分数。 一个 LLM 解析器读取 o，并返回一个缺陷标志和分数。 策略先起草若干初始解，对有缺陷的节点进行调试直至固定深度，否则对最佳有效节点进行改进；验证分数最好的节点会被提交，并在隐藏测试集上依据排行榜进行评分。 每个节点的代价是一次执行。

paragraphs.en: Predicting the terminal output alone is not enough. Without an explicit exception type, the model must infer from free text whether the run crashed, and AIDE reads the validation score only through a separate feedback model that extracts it from the output (Section 3.1 ). We therefore predict both as their own fields, whose labels AIDE already logs. Adding them raises agreement on terminal output from 59.4% to 62.8% and metric recall from 84.3% to 89.5% (Appendix D ). The exception type also yields the outcome distribution behind our confidence score, defined next.
paragraphs.zh: 仅预测终端输出是不够的。 在没有显式异常类型的情况下，模型必须从自由文本推断运行是否崩溃，而 AIDE 只通过一个单独的反馈模型从输出中提取验证分数（第 3.1 节）。 因此我们将两者作为各自的字段进行预测，AIDE 已经记录了它们的标签。 加入它们后，终端输出的一致率从 59.4% 提升到 62.8%，指标召回率从 84.3% 提升到 89.5%（附录 D）。 异常类型还为我们置信度分数背后的结果分布提供了依据，该分数将在下文定义。

paragraphs.en: We build five world model guided TTS policies on MLE-World’s predictions (Section 5.1 ), then add a confidence gate that works with any of them and decides when a prediction needs a real run (Section 5.2 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 MLE-World 的预测之上构建了五个世界模型引导的 TTS 策略（第 5.1 节），然后添加了一个置信度门控，它可与其中任意策略配合使用，用于决定何时需要对预测进行真实运行（第 5.2 节）。

paragraphs.en: MLE-World stands in for execution when comparing candidates: a step draws N N candidates, predicts their outputs y ^ i = h ϕ ​ ( x i ) \hat{y}_{i}=h_{\phi}(x_{i}) , and executes only one. Each of our five policies reads these predictions, not only the code (Figure 2 ; algorithms in Appendix J ). Best-of- N N (BoN) keeps the best predicted validation score ( Brown et al., 2024 ; Nam et al., 2026 ) . Sequential revises each candidate from the previous one’s predicted error trace, log, and score, where prior revision uses real feedback ( Snell et al., 2024 ; Chen et al., 2024 ; Nam et al., 2026 ) . Pairwise extends ForeAgent ( Zheng et al., 2026 ) , which compares candidates without execution feedback: an LLM judge compares two candidates at a time with their predicted terminal outputs until one remains. Fusion synthesizes a new program from the pool and its predicted terminal outputs ( Khairi et al., 2026 ; Nam et al., 2026 ) . UCB adds an exploration bonus from MLE-World’s confidence to the predicted score, as described next.
paragraphs.zh: MLE-World 在比较候选方案时代替执行：一个步骤抽取 N 个候选，预测它们的输出 y ^ i = h ϕ ​ ( x i ) \hat{y}_{i}=h_{\phi}(x_{i}) ，并且只执行其中一个。 我们的五种策略中的每一种都读取这些预测，而不仅仅是代码（图 2；算法见附录 J）。 Best-of-N（BoN）保留最佳预测验证分数（Brown 等，2024；Nam 等，2026）。 Sequential 根据上一个候选的预测错误轨迹、日志和分数依次修订每个候选，其中较早的修订使用真实反馈（Snell 等，2024；Chen 等，2024；Nam 等，2026）。 Pairwise 扩展了 ForeAgent（Zheng 等，2026），后者在没有执行反馈的情况下比较候选：一个 LLM 裁判每次结合预测的终端输出比较两个候选，直到只剩一个。 Fusion 从候选池及其预测的终端输出中合成一个新程序（Khairi 等，2026；Nam 等，2026）。 UCB 将来自 MLE-World 置信度的探索奖励加到预测分数上，如下文所述。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate on 1,700 held out programs, 100 per task and balanced across agent stages. No held out program has an exact or near duplicate copy in training (Appendix E describes the deduplication), but the tasks are shared by design. As in model based RL, where a world model predicts new actions in the environment it was trained on ( Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018 ; Hafner et al., 2019 ; Janner et al., 2019 ) , the task is the environment and each new program is an action. We compare against two strong prompted coder models, DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 (DeepSeek) and Qwen3-Coder-Next (Coder), and three corpus baselines that copy records from MLE-World’s training data without a model: task majority, nearest program, and parent record (see Appendix F for details of each method). Because exact matching misses rewordings and conflates crashes with different causes, a Coder judge scores terminal output and crash class; it agrees with held out human labels on 96.7% (Appendix I ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们在 1,700 个留出程序上进行评估，每个任务 100 个，并在各个智能体阶段之间保持均衡。 没有任何留出程序在训练集中存在完全相同或近似重复的副本（附录 E 描述了去重过程），但任务在设计上是共享的。 正如基于模型的强化学习中，世界模型在其训练所处的环境中预测新动作（Ha 和 Schmidhuber, 2018；Hafner 等, 2019；Janner 等, 2019），任务即环境，每个新程序即一个动作。 我们与两个强大的提示式编码模型 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731（DeepSeek）和 Qwen3-Coder-Next（Coder），以及三个无需模型、直接从 MLE-World 训练数据中复制记录的语料库基线进行比较：任务多数、最近程序和父记录（各方法的细节见附录 F）。 由于精确匹配会漏掉改写表述，并将不同原因导致的崩溃混为一谈，因此由一个 Coder 裁判对终端输出和崩溃类别进行评分；它与留出的人工标注的一致率为 96.7%（附录 I）。

paragraphs.en: Table 1 shows that MLE-World’s predicted terminal output matches the observed output on 77.9% of held out programs, compared with 41.1% for DeepSeek, the strongest prompted baseline. The corpus controls clarify what the model learns: task level statistics already predict many validation scores, but retrieving a similar program’s record rarely reproduces its failure cause, since a one line difference in code can produce a different error. MLE-World’s advantage on both fields supports learning relationships between programs and their execution outcomes beyond those captured by the tested baselines. As shown in Figure 3 , its GPU inference time is 13–1,061 × \times lower than that of the prompted models, making these predictions practical for screening multiple candidates.

paragraphs.en: Our main evaluation is in distribution: new programs on 17 tasks seen in finetuning (Appendix E ). On three tasks excluded from finetuning, the 4B MLE-World, without reasoning, still predicts terminal output more accurately than much larger prompted models (53.3% versus 42.1% for DeepSeek with reasoning and 21.1% for Coder; Appendix R ). This opens a generalizable world model as future work, for example by adding reasoning or scaling up the model. Training uses about 500,000 prior executions, including earlier trajectories from a 9B agent but no reported runs, favoring settings with accumulated logs. Zero shot baselines and Base AIDE lack this task knowledge; nonparametric corpus baselines trail MLE-World (Table 1 ), while Base AIDE with corpus access remains untested. Real execution determines final scores; prediction errors can misdirect search. Timeouts are the least accurately predicted outcome, and a missed timeout still costs a full run; improving runtime prediction is future work.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的主要评估为分布内评估：针对微调中见过的 17 个任务上的新程序（附录 E）。 在三个未纳入微调的任务上，4B 的 MLE-World 在不使用推理的情况下，其终端输出预测准确率仍显著高于规模大得多的提示模型（53.3%，相比之下，使用推理的 DeepSeek 为 42.1%，Coder 为 21.1%；附录 R）。 这为构建可泛化的世界模型开辟了未来研究方向，例如通过增加推理能力或扩大模型规模。 训练使用了约 500,000 次先前执行，其中包括来自一个 9B 智能体的早期轨迹，但不包含已报告的运行结果，这有利于拥有积累日志的环境设置。 零样本基线和 Base AIDE 缺乏这种任务知识；非参数语料库基线落后于 MLE-World（表 1），而具备语料库访问权限的 Base AIDE 尚未经过测试。 最终分数由实际执行决定；预测错误可能会误导搜索方向。 超时是预测准确率最低的结果，而漏判一次超时仍会导致一整次运行的损失；改进运行时预测是未来的工作。

paragraphs.en: A 4B model finetuned on logged executions predicts the outcomes of new programs more accurately than much larger prompted models, at 13–1,061 × \times less GPU inference time. This makes test time scaling affordable for MLE agents: all five world model guided policies have higher observed mean percentiles than the agent without a world model. Gating reduces real execution time by 30–40% while broadly maintaining performance.

paragraphs.en: We fix the backbone, training corpus, split, and decoding, and vary only the target. Starting from terminal output plus a submission flag, we add the exception class and then the validation metric. We also compare untrimmed logs with the default window of the first and last 2,500 characters, and we train a target of metric plus submission flag with no terminal output. To keep each run affordable, the variants train on a subset of 49,791 programs drawn from nine of the tasks and are scored against executed ground truth on 450 held out programs from those nine tasks (Table 8 ). Absolute scores are therefore not comparable with Table 1 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们固定骨干模型、训练语料、数据划分和解码方式，仅改变目标。 从终端输出加提交标志开始，我们再加入异常类别，然后加入验证指标。 我们还将未截断的日志与默认的前后各2,500字符窗口进行比较，并训练一个不含终端输出的指标加提交标志的目标。 为了让每次运行成本可控，这些变体在从九个任务中抽取的49,791个程序子集上训练，并在来自这九个任务的450个保留程序上对照执行后的标准答案进行评分（表8）。 因此，绝对分数与表1不可比。

paragraphs.en: Agents rarely resubmit byte identical code; repeated attempts usually differ only in comments or formatting. We therefore key each program on a hash of its Python token stream with comments and blank lines removed and indentation and line breaks normalized. Programs that differ only in comments, spacing, or blank lines share a key; any change to identifiers, literals, or structure does not. Programs that fail to tokenize fall back to a hash of their raw bytes. Before deduplication, we drop executions whose outcome reflects the harness rather than the program, such as GPU contention, host memory limits, or network failures. Deduplication then collapses 757,186 executions to 602,741. When the same program produced different outcomes across runs (for example, a timeout in one run and a clean finish in another), we keep one representative per outcome rather than an arbitrary winner.
paragraphs.zh: 智能体很少会重新提交字节完全相同的代码；重复提交的代码通常只在注释或格式上有所不同。 因此，我们以每个程序的 Python 词法单元流的哈希值作为键，其中移除了注释和空行，并将缩进与换行进行了归一化。 仅在注释、空格或空行上有差异的程序共享同一个键；而对标识符、字面量或结构的任何更改则不会共享键。 无法进行词法分析的程序则退回到使用其原始字节的哈希值。 在去重之前，我们会剔除那些结果反映的是测试环境而非程序本身的执行，例如 GPU 争用、主机内存限制或网络故障。 去重之后，757,186 次执行被压缩为 602,741 次。 当同一程序在不同运行中产生了不同结果时（例如，某次运行超时而另一次运行顺利完成），我们会为每种结果各保留一个代表性样本，而不是任意挑选一个。

paragraphs.en: From the 602,741 deduplicated executions we remove 43,836 on tasks outside our 17, 33,591 whose output contains a progress bar (agents are told not to print them), 13,121 whose validation metric cannot be resolved unambiguously, 11,549 cut short by the agent’s overall deadline and logged as timeouts, and 1,888 with harness failures, invalid stage labels, or mislabeled interrupts. This leaves 498,756 executions.

paragraphs.en: From these 498,756 executions, we sample 100 programs per task, balanced across agent stages (draft, improve, debug) and between fast ( ≤ \leq 5 s) and slow executions. We draw only programs without a detected exact or near duplicate among the other programs of their task (procedure below), then remove the sampled programs from training. The remaining 497,056 executions form the training set.
paragraphs.zh: 从这 498,756 次执行中，我们为每个任务抽取 100 个程序，并在智能体的各个阶段（起草、改进、调试）之间以及快速（≤ 5 秒）执行与慢速执行之间保持均衡。 我们仅抽取在所属任务的其他程序中未检测到完全重复或近似重复的程序（程序见下文），然后从训练集中移除这些被抽样的程序。 剩余的 497,056 次执行构成训练集。

paragraphs.en: Exact keys miss programs that differ only in identifier names or in a few edits. We therefore replace identifiers with placeholders and treat two programs as duplicates when their identifier normalized abstract syntax trees hash identically, and as near duplicates when MinHash with locality sensitive hashing estimates a Jaccard similarity of at least 0.9 between their identifier normalized token shingles (128 permutations in 16 bands of 8 rows, within each task). No exact or near duplicates were detected between holdout and training under this procedure. The probabilistic MinHash/LSH search can miss similar pairs; it does not rule out semantic similarity or overlap across tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 精确键匹配会漏掉仅在标识符命名或少量编辑上存在差异的程序。 因此，我们将标识符替换为占位符，并把两个程序视为重复：当它们标识符归一化后的抽象语法树哈希完全相同时视为完全重复，当用带局部敏感哈希的 MinHash 估计其标识符归一化后的词元 shingle 之间的 Jaccard 相似度不低于 0.9 时视为近似重复（在每个任务内部使用 16 个波段、每波段 8 行、共 128 个置换）。 在该流程下，保留集与训练集之间未检测到任何完全重复或近似重复。 基于概率的 MinHash/LSH 搜索可能漏掉相似的程序对；它并不能排除跨任务之间的语义相似性或重叠。

paragraphs.en: Held out programs are new, but their tasks also appear in training. paragraphs.zh: 留出的程序是新的，但其任务也出现在训练中。 这类似于基于模型的强化学习，其中世界模型在同一环境中进行训练和评估，并且必须预测新动作的结果，而不是新环境（Ha and Schmidhuber, 2018; Hafner et al., 2019; Janner et al., 2019）。 这里任务就是环境，执行程序就是一个动作：智能体为其正在解决的任务编写数百个新程序，因此 MLE-World 必须预测已知任务中未见过的程序。

paragraphs.en: The judge scores terminal output and crash class, which require semantic comparison. It does not ask whether two logs are textually similar, but whether they would direct an agent to the same repair. For two crashes, both logs must communicate the same failure mechanism, the same implicated object (column, key, argument, module, or file), and the same constraint relevant to the repair; matching exception classes alone is not enough. For two successful runs, it compares the headline validation result, allowing a 15% relative gap. Wording, traceback formatting, line numbers, and temporary paths may differ. The full prompt is reproduced below.

paragraphs.en: Each arm runs for eight hours on 17 tasks with three matched seeds: 11–13 for Improve and 34–36 for Debug (51 trials per arm). We use Qwen3.5-9B, the 4B world model at step 6,685, and Qwen3-Coder-Next feedback. Models, sampling, parent selection, and review settings match within each pair. Leakage rejection is enabled; submission consistency review rejects in Improve and is advisory in Debug. Every selection requests a real check, subject to timeout skipping and remaining budget. Mean percentile weights tasks equally after averaging seeds; invalid or missing submissions score zero.

paragraphs.en: The gate uses one pair of raw p max p_{\max} thresholds at every stage: γ s \gamma_{\mathrm{s}} when MLE-World predicts success and γ f \gamma_{\mathrm{f}} when it predicts a failure other than a timeout. The two thresholds differ for two reasons. First, predicted successes and predicted failures have different p max p_{\max} distributions, so they trade prediction error for skipped runtime differently (Figure 9 ), and a single threshold would place them at different operating points: about 15% error requires γ s = 0.90 \gamma_{\mathrm{s}}=0.90 for successes but only γ f = 0.83 \gamma_{\mathrm{f}}=0.83 for failures. Second, they differ in cost. Predicted successes, two thirds of them Improve programs, are the long runs (median 115 s), so we want to skip as many of them as possible. Predicted failures, mostly Debug programs, usually crash within seconds (median 3 s), so running them is cheap and returns the exact error trace to repair. Predicted timeouts are never run (the timeout skip, Section 5.2 ): a real run of a program that times out occupies the executor for the full time limit and blocks the search, only to confirm a failure the prediction already reports.
paragraphs.zh: 该门控在每一阶段都使用一对原始 p max p_{\max} 阈值：当 MLE-World 预测成功时使用 γ s \gamma_{\mathrm{s}}，当预测到除超时之外的失败时使用 γ f \gamma_{\mathrm{f}}。 这两个阈值不同的原因有两个。 首先，预测成功与预测失败的 p max p_{\max} 分布不同，因此它们在预测错误与跳过运行时间之间的权衡方式也不同（图 9），单一阈值会把它们置于不同的工作点上：大约 15% 的错误率对成功而言需要 γ s = 0.90 \gamma_{\mathrm{s}}=0.90，而对失败而言只需要 γ f = 0.83 \gamma_{\mathrm{f}}=0.83。 其次，两者的代价不同。 预测成功的程序中有三分之二是 Improve 程序，属于长时运行（中位数 115 秒），因此我们希望尽可能多地跳过它们。 预测失败的程序大多是 Debug 程序，通常会在几秒内崩溃（中位数 3 秒），因此运行它们代价很低，还能返回用于修复的确切错误轨迹。 预测超时的程序从不运行（即超时跳过，见 5.2 节）：对一个会超时的程序进行真实运行会占用智能体执行器整个时限并阻塞搜索，最终却只是确认一个预测早已报告的失败。

paragraphs.en: BoN (real execution) runs four real candidates in parallel per step and selects by their observed validation scores. The same 17 tasks and three seeds use a step target matched to the mean search length of world model guided BoN, subject to a 16 h cap. Some trials reach the cap before the step target. Table 18 reports both the 8 h cutoff and final results. The cutoff carries forward each trial’s validation-selected submission published by 28,800 seconds, with zero before a valid publication; it is read retrospectively from these 16 h-cap runs. We independently grade the final published submissions; 48 are valid and the three missing submissions count as zero. Mean leaderboard percentile is 44.96 at 11.90 hours of real execution and cleanup per trial; mean total trial duration is 12.98 h. Execution time is the duration of the union of timestamped execution and cleanup intervals across all 10,444 candidate attempts: parallel activity counts once. It excludes inference and idle time outside those intervals. All trials finish within the 16 h cap. The 8 h policy comparisons have no overlapping execution intervals, so this accounting leaves their reported costs unchanged. The archived cohorts differ in source revision, serving, execution capacity, and concurrency density, so the comparison is descriptive.
paragraphs.zh: BoN（真实执行）在每个步骤并行运行四个真实候选，并根据其观测到的验证得分进行选择。 使用相同的 17 个任务和三个种子，其步骤目标与世界模型引导的 BoN 的平均搜索长度相匹配，并以 16 小时上限为约束。 一些试验在达到步骤目标之前就到达了上限。 表 18 同时报告了 8 小时截止和最终结果。 截止时间沿用每个试验在 28,800 秒前发布的经验证选出的提交，有效发布之前记为零；该数据是从这些 16 小时上限的运行中回溯读取的。 我们独立对最终发布的提交进行评分；48 个有效，三个缺失的提交计为零。 在每次试验 11.90 小时的真实执行与清理时间下，平均排行榜百分位为 44.96；平均总试验时长为 12.98 小时。 执行时间是所有 10,444 次候选尝试中带时间戳的执行与清理区间的并集的时长：并行的活动只计一次。 它不包括这些区间之外的推理和空闲时间。 所有试验都在 16 小时上限内完成。 8 小时策略比较没有重叠的执行区间，因此这种核算使其报告的成本保持不变。 归档的队列在源修订版本、服务方式、执行能力和并发密度上各不相同，因此该比较仅是描述性的。

sents.zh: 使用相同的 17 个任务和三个种子，其步骤目标与世界模型引导的 BoN 的平均搜索长度相匹配，并以 16 小时上限为约束。

sents.en: Some trials reach the cap before the step target.
sents.zh: 一些试验在达到步骤目标之前就到达了上限。

sents.en: Table 18 reports both the 8 h cutoff and final results.
sents.zh: 表 18 同时报告了 8 小时截止和最终结果。

sents.en: The cutoff carries forward each trial’s validation-selected submission published by 28,800 seconds, with zero before a valid publication; it is read retrospectively from these 16 h-cap runs.
sents.zh: 截止时间沿用每个试验在 28,800 秒前发布的经验证选出的提交，有效发布之前记为零；该数据是从这些 16 小时上限的运行中回溯读取的。

sents.zh: 我们独立对最终发布的提交进行评分；48 个有效，三个缺失的提交计为零。

sents.zh: 在每次试验 11.90 小时的真实执行与清理时间下，平均排行榜百分位为 44.96；平均总试验时长为 12.98 小时。

paragraphs.en: Table 19 and the remaining diagnostics use earlier 8 h cohorts. Without the gate, world model guided policies run fewer programs than the agent without a world model, and a larger share of them finish cleanly. The gate removes 48–73% of the remaining runs. Four of the five policies have a higher clean run share with the gate; all five lose less time to timeouts, consistent with skipping programs whose outcome MLE-World predicts confidently. Split by agent stage, ungated guidance moves real execution from Debug to Improve. Per trial, Base AIDE spends 0.80 hours in Draft, 3.29 in Debug, and 2.56 in Improve (39% of its execution). Debug falls to 2.23, 2.49, 1.86, 2.37, and 2.23 hours for Sequential, Pairwise, Fusion, BoN, and UCB, and Improve takes 40%, 48%, 52%, 49%, and 48% of execution. Sequential is the exception: its Improve share stays near Base AIDE’s. Clean Improve runs account for 1.19 hours in Base AIDE and 1.19, 1.61, 2.25, 2.01, and 1.84 hours in the same order. Gated policies record fewer verified new bests per trial, most visibly Fusion, but reach their first verified submission about as early. With the gate, policies also commit more programs to the search tree per trial (a world model guided step first predicts four candidates): 67.8 instead of 49.5 for Sequential, 103.5 instead of 65.2 for Pairwise, 77.8 instead of 59.8 for Fusion, 115.5 instead of 68.3 for BoN, and 111.9 instead of 71.9 for UCB. Base AIDE, which runs every program, commits 144.9.
paragraphs.zh: 表 19 及其余诊断使用较早的 8 小时批次。 没有门控时，世界模型引导的智能体运行的程序数量少于没有世界模型的智能体，但其中顺利完成的比例更大。 门控去除了剩余运行的 48–73%。 五个策略中有四个在启用门控后干净运行占比更高；全部五个策略因超时而损失的时间都更少，这与跳过那些 MLE-World 能有把握预测其结果的程序相一致。 按智能体阶段划分，未门控的引导使真实执行从调试阶段转向改进阶段。 每次试验中，Base AIDE 在草拟阶段花费 0.80 小时，调试阶段 3.29 小时，改进阶段 2.56 小时（占其执行的 39%）。 Sequential、Pairwise、Fusion、BoN 和 UCB 的调试阶段分别降至 2.23、2.49、1.86、2.37 和 2.23 小时，改进阶段分别占执行的 40%、48%、52%、49% 和 48%。 Sequential 是例外：其改进阶段占比仍接近 Base AIDE 的水平。 干净的改进阶段运行在 Base AIDE 中占 1.19 小时，在上述相同顺序的各策略中分别为 1.19、1.61、2.25、2.01 和 1.84 小时。 门控策略每次试验记录的经核实的新最优结果更少，其中 Fusion 最为明显，但它们首次获得经核实的提交的时间大致相同。 启用门控后，各策略每次试验向搜索树提交的程序也更多（世界模型引导的一步会先预测四个候选）：Sequential 从 49.5 提高到 67.8，Pairwise 从 65.2 提高到 103.5，Fusion 从 59.8 提高到 77.8，BoN 从 68.3 提高到 115.5，UCB 从 71.9 提高到 111.9。 运行每个程序的 Base AIDE 提交了 144.9 个。

Each produces one format valid candidate that is rejected by metric review. The two bird trials suffer repeated data parsing errors, including 178 recorded ParserError s. paragraphs.en: Table 20 fixes the starting task state to isolate what MLE-World’s predictions contribute to a local decision, separately from the rest of the search. We sample 153 states from recorded agent runs, three per task and stage (draft, debug, improve) on each of the 17 tasks, without consulting their outcomes. At each state, Qwen3.5-9B generates four candidates and MLE-World predicts their terminal outputs and structured fields. Selection, Pairwise, and Fusion use these same four candidates; Sequential shares the first candidate and generates three revisions under each feedback condition. We execute and grade every candidate and every program a rule produces; each rule’s choice is recorded before any private test grade is read. We omit UCB because these local outcomes do not measure the value of exploration through later search decisions.

paragraphs.en: To isolate the contribution of predictions, we fix the task state and its four generated candidates, execute and grade every candidate, and vary only how the predictions are used (Table 20 ). Screening and Fusion show the clearest gains in this controlled comparison. First, the predictions prevent failed runs: choosing among the candidates MLE-World predicts will run raises the share of chosen programs that yield a valid submission from 26.1% to 41.9% ( + 15.8 +15.8 points), and predicted feedback raises fusion’s share from 36.7% to 49.2% ( + 12.5 +12.5 points). As in complete runs, the chosen program executes about as long (256 versus 260 seconds), but more of that time goes to runs that finish cleanly (135 versus 96 seconds; + 39 +39 seconds). Second, test percentile rises by 5.51 and 6.55 points, mostly through this higher validity. Subsequent metric ranking adds only 0.68 points after screening. Fusion’s observed means with predicted and real feedback are 20.6 and 20.4 percentile.
paragraphs.zh: 为了隔离预测的贡献，我们固定任务状态及其四个已生成的候选，执行并评估每个候选，仅改变预测的使用方式（表20）。 在这一受控比较中，筛选与融合显示出最明显的提升。 首先，预测可以防止失败的运行：在 MLE-World 预测能够运行的候选中进行选择，使被选程序产生有效提交的比例从 26.1% 提高到 41.9%（+15.8 分），而预测的反馈使融合的这一比例从 36.7% 提高到 49.2%（+12.5 分）。 与完整运行一致，被选程序的执行时长大致相同（256 秒对 260 秒），但更多时间用于能够顺利完成的运行（135 秒对 96 秒；+39 秒）。 其次，测试百分位分别提升 5.51 分和 6.55 分，这主要来自更高的有效性。 在筛选之后的后续指标排名仅增加 0.68 分。 使用预测反馈与真实反馈时，融合的观测均值分别为 20.6 和 20.4 百分位。

paragraphs.en: MLE-bench compares each final submission with the competition’s human leaderboard. We use percentile as the primary metric because medal rates are all or nothing: 12 of our 17 tasks never yield a gold, while one task with a small leaderboard yields more than half of all golds. Hambardzumyan et al. (2026) likewise rank agents by percentile because medal thresholds amplify noise and hide progress on hard tasks, and Foster et al. (2026) report a continuous normalized score. Tables 21 and 22 break down the 306 final submissions of the six earlier 8 h ungated policies by task and by policy.

paragraphs.en: New tasks can reuse familiar execution operations: loading images, transforming tensors, and adapting pretrained models. Failures in these shared operations may remain predictable even when the data and prediction target change (Table 24 ). Task-specific geometry, labels, and metrics introduce less familiar behavior. Shared code therefore offers a plausible route to transfer, though training family ablations are needed to establish its role.
paragraphs.zh: 新任务可以复用熟悉的执行操作：加载图像、变换张量以及适配预训练模型。 即使数据和预测目标发生变化，这些共享操作中的失败仍可能保持可预测性（表 24）。 任务特定的几何结构、标签和指标会引入不太熟悉的行为。 因此，共享代码为迁移提供了一条可行的路径，但需要通过训练族消融实验来确立其作用。

sents.zh: 因此，共享代码为迁移提供了一条可行的路径，但需要通过训练族消融实验来确立其作用。

paragraphs.en: The pooled and per-task results (Tables 23 and 25 ) suggest that execution prediction can transfer to tasks excluded from finetuning, with gains that vary across output fields. Because failed executions dominate the sample, the evidence mainly concerns recognizing execution failures on new tasks. Predicting successful training outcomes and timeouts remains less established. A broader, prospectively selected evaluation and training family ablations would help distinguish transfer through shared code from generalization across task families and software environments.
